name: dungeon-chest-save
comment: WP-1.7: the dungeon of worldgen/overworld-seed-123-dungeon through the save path. Preloading the 3x3 around chunk (1,1) populates it (WorldGenDungeons: mob spawner at (31,13,28), chests at (29,13,28) and (30,13,30)); the save writes the chests' loot (pickCheckLootItem draws on the generator's Random) and the spawner's EntityId (pickMobSpawner) as TileEntities, so the tile_entity lines pin the loot and mob draws. The Rust save path is WP-1.9b.
